question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a **complete front-left brake replacement on your Voltrieve Fjord AWD**, you need the following nine items. The AWD uses **370 mm front brakes**, not the RWD’s 345 mm brakes.  
*Job requirements: voltrieve-service-guide.md.*

| Qty | Spare part | Article number |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm ventilated | **VP-10072** |
| 1 set | Front-axle brake pads for 370 mm discs-covers both sides | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 kit | Front caliper fitting kit-slide pins, bolts and anti-rattle clips for one side | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1 litre | **VP-15168** |

*Source for all part descriptions, fitment and article numbers: voltrieve-parts-brakes.md.*

**Important:** The pads must be replaced on **both front wheels** as an axle set, even when the complete replacement is only on the left. The right-hand disc and caliper stay unless they are also worn. The brake fluid is needed to bleed the circuit afterwards.  
*Source: voltrieve-service-guide.md.*

question: brakes-spark
answer:
For a **complete rear-right brake replacement on your Voltrieve Spark (RWD)**, the service guide requires the following eight items. Quantities are based on *voltrieve-service-guide.md*; article numbers are from the catalogs cited below.

| Qty | Part | Article number | Catalog source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rear-right brake disc | **VP-10917** | *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md* |
| 1 set | Rear-axle brake pads, covering both sides | **VP-10982** | *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md* |
| 1 | Rear-right brake caliper | **VP-11112** | *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md* |
| 1 | Rear-right caliper carrier | **VP-11203** | *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md* |
| 1 | Rear-right brake hose | **VP-11255** | *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md* |
| 1 kit | Rear-axle caliper fitting kit, for one side | **VP-11307** | *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md* |
| 1 | Rear-right brake dust shield | **VP-11398** | *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md* |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1 litre | **VP-15168** | *voltrieve-parts-service-items.md* |

**Important:** Pads must be replaced on **both sides of the rear axle**, even though you are replacing only the right-hand disc and caliper. The Spark has **no electrical pad wear sensor**, so none is required. “Right” is viewed from the driver’s seat.  
Source: *voltrieve-service-guide.md*.

question: brakes-atlas
answer:
For a **complete front-right brake replacement on your Voltrieve Atlas (AWD)**, order the following. Quantities are from *voltrieve-service-guide.md*; article numbers and part details are from *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*.

| Qty | Part to order | Article number |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Front-right brake disc, 400 mm ventilated | **VP-10176** |
| 1 set | Front-axle brake pads, covering both left and right sides | **VP-10267** |
| 1 | Front-right brake caliper, six-piston fixed | **VP-10449** |
| 1 | Front-right brake hose | **VP-10657** |
| 1 | Front-right pad wear sensor | **VP-10683** |
| 1 kit | Front-axle caliper fitting kit, for one side | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-right brake dust shield | **VP-10839** |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1 litre | **VP-15168** |

**No caliper carrier is needed**: the Atlas has a fixed front caliper. The pads must be replaced on **both sides of the front axle**, even for a right-side job; the left disc and caliper remain unless they are also worn. “Right” is viewed from the driver’s seat.  
*Source: voltrieve-service-guide.md.*

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
For a **complete front-left brake replacement**, you need the eight items below. **Confirm whether your Lumen is RWD or AWD before ordering**: RWD uses 300 mm front brakes; AWD uses 320 mm.  
*Source: voltrieve-service-guide.md.*

Buy **one of each item**, choosing the appropriate drive column:

| Part | Lumen RWD article number | Lumen AWD article number |
|---|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc | **VP-10020** - 300 mm | **VP-10033** - 320 mm |
| Front-axle brake pad set, covering both sides | **VP-10202** | **VP-10215** |
| Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10293** | **VP-10306** |
| Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10475** | **VP-10488** |
| Front-left brake hose | **VP-10618** | **VP-10618** |
| Front caliper fitting kit - slide pins, bolts and anti-rattle clips for one side | **VP-10696** | **VP-10696** |
| Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10735** | **VP-10735** |
| DOT 4 LV brake fluid - 1-litre bottle | **VP-15168** | **VP-15168** |

*Article numbers, fitment and package descriptions: voltrieve-parts-brakes.md. Required quantities: voltrieve-service-guide.md.*

Two important points:
- **Replace the pads on both front sides**, even though you are rebuilding only the left brake. The right disc and caliper stay unless they are worn too.
- **No electrical pad wear sensor is needed** on the Lumen. The brake circuit needs bleeding afterward.

*Source: voltrieve-service-guide.md.*
